prompt: Finance flagged a few problems with FX conversion in fxledger: (1) a rate is only found if there's an entry for that exact day — on weekends/holidays fall back to the most recent earlier rate (never a later one); (2) we often only have the opposite pair (USD→EUR when we need EUR→USD), so use the inverse when the direct pair isn't available; (3) converted amounts must be rounded half-up to the target currency's minor units (JPY has none, KWD has 3, most have 2). ledger_total should round each converted entry before summing. Keep raising KeyError when there's no usable rate at all.
